Dana Liu: Need clarity - we had a client dinner in Barcelona. Restaurant gave one combined bill for table of 8 but several people left early and paid their share separately on cards. Also the tip was left in cash by one attendee and no receipt. How do I submit so finance splits correctly?
Chris Vega (Sales): We split by person at the table but the restaurant only gave one folio. I have screenshots of everyones card receipts plus a photo of the signed folio.
Dana Liu: Also, one attendee extended their stay for a personal day and asked to have their meal excluded from company expense. How do we indicate that in Expensely?
Maria (People Ops): Good questions. Upload the restaurant folio, each individual's card receipts (photos/screenshots), and a short note from the meeting owner confirming which lines are company-related. For the attendee who had a personal meal, mark them as "excluded" in the description and show their card payment.
Sam Patel (Finance): For the missing cash tip: tips paid in cash without a merchant receipt are reimbursable only if the claimant paid the cash and provides an attestation plus manager approval. So whoever paid the cash tip needs to submit a short attestation (one paragraph) stating amount and reason and attach witness confirmation (e.g., note from meeting host).
Dana Liu: If we aggregate into a single expense, how should the expense type and coding look?
Sam Patel (Finance): Use this template in Expensely (copy/paste):
```
Expense type: "Client Entertainment - Meals"
Project/Cost center: "Sales - EMEA"
GL account: "5200 - Meals & Entertainment"
Description: "Client dinner (Barcelona) - split folio. Attendee Jaime Morales personal portion excluded. Attach individual card receipts and host confirmation. Cash tip reimbursed to Alex Ruiz (attendee) with attestation. Manager approval attached."
Required attachments: restaurant_folio.jpg, card_receipts_1-5.pdf, cash_tip_attestation.pdf, host_confirmation.pdf
```
Maria (People Ops): Note: foreign currency conversions must match the card statement line. If the folio is in EUR and a personal claimed in GBP, show the card statement conversion line. Finance will use bank conversion rate on the proof-of-payment date.
Chris Vega (Sales): One more: can we allocate part of the meal to a marketing campaign budget? Some of the attendees were agency partners.
Sam Patel (Finance): Yes, you can split lines across cost centers. In Expensely submit as a single expense with split lines (e.g., 60% Sales, 40% Marketing) and include a short CSV or table in the description mapping amounts to cost centers. Manager approvals from both teams required.
expense-bot: Reminder: redact full card numbers on photos, max 10MB per attachment, and attach attestation for cash payments.
Dana Liu: Thanks all  I'll collect receipts and manager notes and submit as one consolidated claim.
